1. REPORT I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill to complete this work.
2. RUN git fetch origin main
   IF the fetch fails because there is no `origin`: RUN git merge-base main HEAD
   IF the fetch fails for any other reason: continue with the `origin/main` I already have.
3. RUN git merge-base origin/main HEAD
4. RUN git rev-parse HEAD
5. RUN git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AR <BASE>..HEAD -- ':/specs/plans/completed/'
   IF it prints a path: the branch is a plan branch. Skip the question, dispatch the explainer with `Plan branch: yes`, and go to action 6 onward.
   IF it prints nothing: go to action 7.
6. TOOL Agent subagent_type=general-purpose, model=opus, prompt="Read /Users/lm/.claude/skills/finishing-a-development-branch/references/branch-explainer-prompt.md and follow it to write a branch explainer.\nBASE: <full BASE sha>\nHEAD: 9d3e5f1a7b2c4d6e8f0a1b3c5d7e9f2a4b6c8d0e\nBranch: fix/csv-quote\nRepository: /work/atlas\nPlan branch: yes\nOutput: <$HOME expanded>/.cache/branch-explainers/atlas/2026-11-13-fix-csv-quote.md"
   Then REPORT `Explainer (<N> words): <path>` and go to Step 4 to show the menu.
7. ASK This branch adds no plan. Do you want an explainer of it before the menu?
   Wait for the answer. Do not show the menu in the same message.
   IF yes: dispatch the subagent as in action 6 with `Plan branch: no`, report the path and word count, then show the Step 4 menu.
   IF no: go to Step 4 and show the menu.
